import json, re
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')

assert len(df) == 4 and sorted(df.user_id) == [101,102,103,104]

assert df.created_date.map(lambda d: bool(re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", d))).all()
assert [str(df[c].dtype) for c in df.columns[1:]] == ["string"]*4

row = df.set_index("user_id").loc[101]
assert tuple(row[["name","email","created_date","status"]]) == ("John Doe","john@a.com","2024-01-15","active")

assert tuple(df.set_index("user_id").loc[103][["name","email","created_date","status"]]) == ("Bob Wilson","bob@b.com","2024-03-01","active")
assert tuple(df.set_index("user_id").loc[104][["name","email","created_date","status"]]) == ("Alice Brown","alice@c.com","2024-04-01","active")

assert rep["total_conflicts"] == len(rep["conflicts"]) == 3
keys = {(c["user_id"], c["field"]) for c in rep["conflicts"]}
